incidents.name: BeyondTrust Remote Support appliance intrusion (single Mandiant IR engagement)
incidents.rationale: One engagement described end to end; no second victim or wave reported.

adversary.finding: ARMORY CASTLE (formerly UNC5221), suspected PRC-nexus espionage
adversary.evidence: suspected PRC-nexus espionage threat actor (formerly tracked as UNC5221)
adversary.confidence: High (vendor attribution); Medium (state nexus, hedged as 'suspected')

capability.finding: CVE-2026-102764 zero-day; SAWFLY; BARECLAW; unrecovered staging shell; abuse of bt-secrets, bt-sysconfig, haproxy.conf
capability.evidence: newly identified custom malware, the SAWFLY webshell and the BARECLAW tunneler

infrastructure.finding: No external C2 IPs or domains published. Victim appliance used as the pivot; inbound via /uidchanarge through HAProxy.
infrastructure.evidence: routes the incoming web stream locally (127.0.0.1 / localhost) to TCP port 19800
infrastructure.confidence: High for on-box infrastructure; none for adversary-owned infrastructure

victim.finding: One organization running self-hosted or appliance BeyondTrust RS; sector and geography not disclosed

meta.timeframe: Exploitation late Aug 2026; SaaS patched 2026-10-09; disclosure 2026-10-15

Weaponization: Zero-day exploit for CVE-2026-102764 (implied, no technique ID)

atlas_applicability: Not applicable. No AI/ML system is targeted or abused in INC-1.

technique_mappings.behavior: Zero-day exploitation of CVE-2026-102764 in BeyondTrust Remote Support
technique_mappings.evidence: exploited this vulnerability as a zero-day, in late August 2026
technique_mappings.rationale: Stated outright, with CVE and timeframe.

technique_mappings.behavior: Unrecovered staging webshell, then SAWFLY written to the Laravel web root
technique_mappings.evidence: the file system recorded the creation of the SAWFLY webshell at the web root path
technique_mappings.rationale: Named malware, path and file-system timestamp.

technique_mappings.behavior: SAWFLY is obfuscated PHP with an obfuscated trigger parameter
technique_mappings.evidence: SAWFLY (mangoapi.php) is an obfuscated, lightweight PHP webshell
technique_mappings.rationale: Stated; sub-technique not determinable from text.

technique_mappings.behavior: Base32 wrapping of SAWFLY C2 traffic
technique_mappings.evidence: a custom Base32 transport layer
technique_mappings.rationale: Report says 'custom', but the YARA string is the standard RFC 4648 alphabet, so .001 over .002 is tentative.

technique_mappings.behavior: RC4 with a hardcoded 32-byte key (SAWFLY); token-derived XOR stream (BARECLAW)
technique_mappings.evidence: decrypts it using RC4 with a hardcoded 32-byte key
technique_mappings.rationale: Cipher and key handling stated for both tools.

technique_mappings.behavior: C2 over HTTP POST to SAWFLY; WebSocket to BARECLAW through HAProxy
technique_mappings.evidence: The webshell inspects incoming HTTP POST requests for the obfuscated parameter _c94mfe
technique_mappings.rationale: Transport stated.

technique_mappings.behavior: sh -c log deletion and a bash persistence script
technique_mappings.evidence: /usr/sbin/sh -c 'rm -f /home/bomgar/log/bt-secrets.log ...'
technique_mappings.rationale: Recovered commands shown verbatim.

technique_mappings.behavior: Copied /bin/sh to /usr/bin/dbus-authd, chowned to root, set SUID
technique_mappings.evidence: copied the system shell executable (/bin/sh) to the file /usr/bin/dbus-authd
technique_mappings.rationale: Stated with file path and permission change.

technique_mappings.technique_name: Match Legitimate Resource Name or Location
technique_mappings.behavior: SUID shell named to resemble a D-Bus component in /usr/bin
technique_mappings.evidence: /usr/bin/dbus-authd
technique_mappings.rationale: Analyst inference from the name; the report never calls it masquerading.

technique_mappings.behavior: Dumping the appliance vault with the native bt-secrets CLI
technique_mappings.evidence: /ns/sbin/bt-secrets get vault
technique_mappings.rationale: Attempt is stated; whether the dump succeeded is not.

technique_mappings.behavior: zz-root-persist dropped in the vendor post_boot.d startup directory
technique_mappings.evidence: created the /home/bomgar/sbin/post_boot.d directory, which is reserved for scripts executed automatically at system startup
technique_mappings.rationale: Behavior stated; parent ID used because a vendor post-boot hook is not a standard RC script.

technique_mappings.behavior: NOPASSWD: ALL appended to sudoers.template, rebuilt via bt-sysconfig
technique_mappings.evidence: appends '%SITE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT% ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL' to the template
technique_mappings.rationale: Script contents shown verbatim.

technique_mappings.technique_name: Clear Linux or Mac System Logs
technique_mappings.behavior: rm -f of /var/log/messages and /ns/log/* appliance logs
technique_mappings.evidence: rm -f /ns/log/auth.log ... /var/log/messages
technique_mappings.rationale: Recovered command; T1070.002 is revoked in ATT&CK v20 and points here.

technique_mappings.behavior: Deleted bt-secrets.log, rotated archives and /tmp/sshauth.*
technique_mappings.evidence: rm -f /home/bomgar/log/bt-secrets.log /home/bomgar/log/bt-secrets.log.*
technique_mappings.rationale: Recovered command.

technique_mappings.tactic: Stealth / Persistence / Privilege Escalation / Initial Access
technique_mappings.behavior: Logged into /login with a compromised Administrator account
technique_mappings.evidence: leveraged the Administrator account to log into the web administrative portal
technique_mappings.rationale: Stated, with syslog login event.

technique_mappings.behavior: Raised Jump Item and Team roles from No Access to Administrator
technique_mappings.evidence: upgrading both local Jump Items and Team permissions from No Access to Administrator
technique_mappings.rationale: Stated, with user_changed syslog event.

technique_mappings.behavior: Used the product's own support sessions to reach internal endpoints
technique_mappings.evidence: establish a remote support session to target internal endpoints
technique_mappings.rationale: Stated; the legitimate tool is the lateral-movement channel.

technique_mappings.behavior: Requested full file-system access on reached endpoints
technique_mappings.evidence: request and obtain full file-system access
technique_mappings.rationale: Browsing is implied by the access request, not described.

technique_mappings.behavior: Pulled documents such as software inventories from user desktops
technique_mappings.evidence: download and exfiltrate sensitive internal documents
technique_mappings.rationale: Stated.

technique_mappings.behavior: Exfiltration through the Remote Support file transfer service
technique_mappings.evidence: native BeyondTrust Remote Support file transfer service to download and exfiltrate
technique_mappings.rationale: Exfil stated; treating the RS channel as C2 is an analyst mapping choice.

technique_mappings.behavior: BARECLAW SOCKS5 on 127.0.0.1:19800, exposed through an HAProxy ACL
technique_mappings.evidence: server websocks5srv 127.0.0.1:19800
technique_mappings.rationale: Config shown verbatim.

technique_mappings.behavior: SOCKS5 carried inside WebSocket
technique_mappings.evidence: a SOCKS5 proxy service carried over the WebSocket transport
technique_mappings.rationale: Stated.

technique_mappings.behavior: BARECLAW binary present at /tmp/ingredi_ws
technique_mappings.evidence: /tmp/ingredi_ws --listen 19800
technique_mappings.rationale: How the binary arrived is not described; inferred from its presence.

threat_actors.name: ARMORY CASTLE
threat_actors.evidence: suspected PRC-nexus espionage threat actor (formerly tracked as UNC5221)

attribution.description: Suspected PRC-nexus espionage actor, formerly tracked as UNC5221. Exploits edge-appliance zero-days; active since at least October 2023 per GTIG.
attribution.evidence: GTIG attributes the zero-day exploitation of CVE-2026-102764 and the subsequent deployment of SAWFLY and BARECLAW to ARMORY CASTLE

related_campaigns.name: Cutting Edge
related_campaigns.description: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day campaign; ATT&CK attributes it to actors variously identified as UNC5221/UTA0178 and UNC5325.
related_campaigns.relationship_note: ATT&CK names UNC5221 among several designations for C0029; hedged, so related-to rather than attributed-to.

summary: Zero-day exploitation of CVE-2026-102764 in BeyondTrust Remote Support by ARMORY CASTLE (fka UNC5221), followed by SUID and sudoers-template privilege persistence, vault access attempts, admin role abuse, BARECLAW tunneling via HAProxy and log wiping.
